message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on artificial wreaths with plastic flowers and a Lygodium vine base. Artificial flowers, foliage and articles made of them fall in heading 6702. Subheading 6702.90 covers other materials, and 6702.10 covers plastic.

The wreath is made mainly of plastic flowers on a vine base, and the vines are obscured. Plastic flowers are what give the wreath its character, so the classification is 6702.10.40 (artificial flowers, foliage and fruit of plastic, other than those of 6702.10.20). The statistical suffix is 6702.10.4000, and I recall this being the right one.

The 6702.10 line itself breaks down as follows: 6702.10.20 covers Christmas decorations and 6702.10.40 covers other. The ruling I'm thinking of may have classified it under 6702.90.65, which is "other: other" for materials other than plastic. The vine is a natural material, but the flowers are plastic and are the predominant visible component, so I'm going with plastic.
